deadline.value: International applicants' Fall 2027 deadline is March 15, 2027 (domestic applicants: May 15, 2027).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Supervisor requirement not stated on the pages checked.

funding.value: Lassonde School of Engineering says it provides a guaranteed funding package to all qualified graduate students; newly admitted international students averaged CAD 37,700.
funding.quote: The Lassonde School of Engineering provides a competitive, guaranteed funding package to all qualified graduate students.

entry_route.value: The regular PhD requires a master's degree; a Direct PhD from a bachelor's degree is also offered with a higher grade requirement (A- in engineering).
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold a master’s degree equivalent to the Mechanical Engineering MASc degree at York University

also.quote: The minimum admission requirement for the Direct PhD program is an “A-” average in each of the past two years of undergraduate studies if you are coming from a past degree in Engineering

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 88 (tests before January 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale (from January 2026), per the program listing.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL (Internet-based) 88 (for tests taken prior to January 2026) or 4.5 (January 2026 and after)
